body:
IGN: Passively
Discord (Name#): Passively 乡#7027
Timezone: Mexico City

Why would you like to join the referee team (brief paragraph):  I was referee before, I really liked it but I decided to switch to media but I felt useless so that's why I retired. I'm trying to come back as referee because I feel I'm ready for the position and is something I love :)

Best time of the week?: Saturdays and Sundays

A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): I've been Moderator for almost a year and I do have experience as a Referee in Avicus as I explained before.

Anything else?: Nothing, thanks.
